parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container with the state. It shares the open state, the reference to the trigger, and the settings (loop, typeahead, closeOnSelect) with all of the parts.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes.

props.name: loop
props.description:
At the last item, the arrow keys move the focus to the first item, and at the first item, to
the last one.

props.name: typeahead
props.description:
Starts the typeahead. When the user types, the focus moves to an item that agrees with the
text.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Closes the menu when the user selects an item. An item can replace this value.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the trigger element. Set it in your own code, or let Menu.Trigger set it.

props.name: children
props.description: The children: the Trigger and the Content.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that opens the menu, with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded. The ArrowDown, Enter, and Space keys open the menu and move the focus to the first item. The ArrowUp key opens it and moves the focus to the last item.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the trigger button.

parts.name: ContextTrigger
parts.description: A surface that opens the menu at the pointer, from a right click, a long press, or the Shift+F10 keys. It makes a plain element and not a button, thus it can contain any content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the surface. The browser then shows its own context menu.

props.name: longPress
props.description: Opens the menu from a long press with a finger or a pen.

props.name: longPressDelay
props.description: The time of the long press, in ms.

props.name: preventTouchCallout
props.description:
Stops the iOS text callout and the text selection on the surface. Without it, the long press
does not work there. Set it to `false` when the surface has text that the user must select.

props.name: tabindex
props.description:
The position in the tab order. The default is `0`, thus a keyboard user can go to the surface
and open the menu with the Shift+F10 keys. Give `-1` when the surface is in a component that
already controls the focus with a roving tabindex, for example a table or a tree.

dataAttributes.name: data-context-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Present on each context-menu surface.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the surface is disabled. The browser then shows its own menu.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Present on each element that opens a menu, a context menu or a different menu.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: `open` or `closed`.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The role="menu" panel that floats. It goes in a portal and takes its position against the trigger. A submenu uses it as its panel.

props.name: offset
props.description:
The distance from the trigger element, on the main axis. The default is `4`. For a context
menu it is `0`, because that menu goes at the pointer, like a native one.

props.name: placement
props.description:
The position against the trigger element. The default is `bottom-start` for a root menu, and
`right-start` for a submenu.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the menu when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the menu when the user interacts outside it.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the menu.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the menu container.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the menu panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-placement
dataAttributes.description: The resolved side of the trigger the panel is on ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left").

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the menu is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Overlay
parts.description: An optional backdrop behind the menu. Put it beside Menu.Content, in Menu.Root. In a chain of submenus, only the root menu must have one.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the overlay.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation operates.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-overlay
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the overlay element.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the menu is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: An action, with role="menuitem". It accepts `onAction`, `disabled`, `closeOnSelect` (which replaces the default of the Root), `textValue` for the typeahead, and an optional stable `value`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The stable identifier, for the typeahead and the keyboard. If you give none, the component
makes one.

props.name: onAction
props.description: The component calls it when the user activates the item.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the item.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Replaces the `closeOnSelect` value of the Root, for this item.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text for the typeahead. Without it, the component uses the text content of the item.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the item.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the item.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is the highlighted one, from the keyboard or from the pointer.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id
dataAttributes.description: The stable identifier of the item: its `value` prop, or an id that the component makes.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id-type
dataAttributes.description: "number" when the `value` of the item is a number. Absent for a string id.

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-item
dataAttributes.description: Marks the element as a keyboard-navigable menu item.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer presses the item.

dataAttributes.name: data-text-value
dataAttributes.description: The text that the typeahead compares, when that text is not the label.

parts.name: Separator
parts.description: A line between the menu items, with role="separator".

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the separator.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the separator.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the separator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-separator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the separator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The separator orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical").

parts.name: Group
parts.description: Contains the items that go together, with role="group". An optional Menu.GroupLabel gives it its name, through aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the group, usually a Menu.GroupLabel and then the Menu.Item parts.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the group.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the group element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-group
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group element.

parts.name: GroupLabel
parts.description: The accessible name of a Menu.Group. The group points at it with aria-labelledby.

props.name: id
props.description: The id. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the name.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the name element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the name element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-group-label
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group label element.

parts.name: SubmenuRoot
parts.description: The container with the state of a submenu. Put it in a Menu.Content, with a Menu.SubmenuTrigger and its own Menu.Content. The settings come from the menu above it.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes.

props.name: loop
props.description:
At the last item, the arrow keys move the focus to the first item. The default comes from the
menu above it.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Starts the typeahead. The default comes from the menu above it.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Closes the menu when the user selects an item. The default comes from the menu above it.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the submenu trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: The children: the SubmenuTrigger and the Content.

parts.name: SubmenuTrigger
parts.description: An element with role="menuitem" that opens its submenu. The pointer, the ArrowRight key, the Enter key, and the Space key open it. It is also an item of the menu above it.

props.name: value
props.description: Stable identifier (used for parent navigation). Auto-generated if omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the trigger is disabled.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text used for typeahead matching. Falls back to text content.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the trigger.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the trigger is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger is the highlighted one, from the keyboard or from the pointer.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id
dataAttributes.description: The stable identifier of the trigger: its `value` prop, or an id that the component makes.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id-type
dataAttributes.description: "number" when the `value` of the trigger is a number. Absent for a string id.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Marks the element as the trigger of its submenu.

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-item
dataAttributes.description: Marks the element as a keyboard-navigable item of the parent menu.

dataAttributes.name: data-submenu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the submenu trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-text-value
dataAttributes.description: The text that the typeahead compares, when that text is not the label.
